title: Toll-free number messages to US and Canada fail with error 30032 until verification is approved
symptoms: 30032 Toll-Free Number Has Not Been Verified
Sends from a newly bought toll-free number fail while verification is pending or was rejected
cause: Since 2024-01-31 Twilio blocks traffic from toll-free numbers whose verification is restricted, pending or rejected. Buying the number does not verify it.
fix: Submit Toll-Free Verification in the Console or through the Messaging Compliance API and wait for approval before sending. A rejected request can be edited and resubmitted for seven days.
apply: curl -u "$TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID:$TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN" "https://messaging.twilio.com/v1/Tollfree/Verifications?PageSize=20"  # send only when status is TWILIO_APPROVED
affected: Toll-free SMS and MMS to US and Canadian mobiles, blocked since 2024-01-31
